image-card.looks: A rounded banner with a full background photo under a colour wash, a large heading and up to two buttons.
image-card.use: A donation or campaign appeal with one or two actions.
image-card.avoid: An appeal without a photo: use a CTA card block.

fields.media_image: A wide photo; text sits over it, so a calm image works best.
fields.content_heading: One or two sentences; it is shown large.
